summary: Iteration 3 tested the 4 new features (Source registry, Reviewer Handoff PDF, Prior-Year Switcher, §7216 Consent Center). Backend (pytest): added /app/backend/tests/test_iteration3_features.py with 11 tests — all PASSED (11/11). Sources returns exactly 8 entries (7 approved + 1 superseded) with revision/date/hash/official_url/tax_years. Preferences GET returns defaults for a fresh user (tax_year=2025, consent_7216=false); POST accepts 2023/2024/2025 and persists cpa_email; rejects 2020 with 400. Consent /consent/7216 rejects accept=false and blank signed_name; on success sets consent_7216=true + timestamp. Revoke sets consent_7216=false and consent_7216_revoked_at. Handoff /handoff/home_office/pdf returned a real PDF (base64 decoded, bytes start with '%PDF', >500 bytes) plus filename+cpa_email; unknown item returns 404. Chat with tax_year=2023 echoes 'tax_year': 2023 in response. Regression: pre-existing test_new_features.py 12/12 PASSED. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844, fresh signup each run): Tax-Year pill on dashboard shows 'Tax Year 2025' by default, opens modal, selecting 2024 persists via /api/preferences and header updates to 'Tax Year 2024'. Setting to 2023 then opening Chat: subtitle correctly reads 'Tax Year 2023' and question receives grounded AI response (1 /api/chat call observed). Profile shows the 3 new rows (§7216 Consent Center, Source registry, Compliance & Guardrails); tapping each navigates correctly. /sources renders 8 source cards with data-testid=source-<id>, approved cards show 'APPROVED' badge, superseded card uses opacity 0.7. /consent full round-trip verified: 'No consent captured' state → typed name + accepted checkbox + Sign → screen switches to 'consent on file' with Revoke button visible → Revoke returns to no-consent state. /deductions: expanding home_office and tapping 'Save for pro review' shows the 'Generate reviewer packet' button (testID handoff-home_office). Tapping it fires exactly one /api/handoff/home_office/pdf call and web download starts (no console errors). No red screen, no runtime errors in console for any flow tested.

minor.issue: Pre-existing JWT jti/iat collision — carried over from iteration_2. Not user-facing; still recommend adding a random jti to make_session_token().

issues: Pre-existing 'Image style.resizeMode is deprecated' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' RN-Web warnings only (non-blocking).

action_items: OPTIONAL: server.py has grown to ~1150 lines (added sources, preferences, consent, handoff routes). Split into routers/ (auth, documents, review, refund, potential_items, chat, sources, preferences, consent, handoff) before next feature — same recommendation as iteration_2.

OPTIONAL: Add DB indexes for new collections: db.preferences.create_index('user_id', unique=True), db.consent_audit.create_index([('user_id',1),('timestamp',-1)]), db.handoff_audit.create_index([('user_id',1),('created_at',-1)]).

OPTIONAL: The 'requires' filter in /handoff/{item_id}/pdf falls back to all docs when requires==[] (student_loan_int), which is fine but could be documented — the PDF then lists every uploaded doc as 'supporting'.
MINOR (carried over): add random jti to JWT to avoid signup+login same-second DuplicateKeyError.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:781 — `supporting = [d for d in docs if d.get('doc_type') in item.get('requires', []) or item.get('requires') == []]` — the second clause makes every doc 'supporting' when requires is empty; acceptable but ambiguous. Consider explicit branch.

PDF is base64-encoded in JSON response (~3KB base64 for a 2.2KB PDF). Fine for MVP, but for larger packets consider StreamingResponse with Content-Disposition on the backend and expo-file-system on native.
Consent audit collection is append-only but has no index on user_id — will slow with growth.

SOURCE_REGISTRY is hardcoded in Python — same 'move to Mongo/JSON per-tax-year' recommendation from iteration_2 applies (aligns with the versioned-authority principle the compliance screen advertises).

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all 4 new features verified end-to-end on mobile viewport
